headline: Clean day — 7 uploads, 30 green runs — and PR #8's new formats (Pokémon-or-medicine, slowed cries, Pokédex-first) are rendered and waiting on your preview check; the nightly analytics job hasn't fired yet, so every number here is still yesterday's.
happened: Mon Nov 16: 3 single Shorts (Fire-type · Ep. 73, Starter, Legendary · Ep. 75), 3 rapid-fires (Generation 3; Ghost-type as a 7-sound, 49 s; Generation 4, which landed at 21:49 ET after the 01 UTC slot slipped) and the Dragon-type long-form (6 min 28 s). All public on YouTube and cross-posted to Instagram and Facebook. 30 workflow runs since yesterday morning, 30 green, nothing in Run failures.

PR #8 opened at 00:44 UTC on the branch you green-lit Sunday ("go for it"): a "Pokémon or medicine?" word quiz for the rapid-fire slots (67 generic drug names), a slowed-down-cries rapid theme, an `order` test for Shorts (open on the cry vs. on the Pokédex line) and a format registry with per-format fitness. Four preview renders came off the branch between 00:46 and 01:13 UTC (Pokémon-or-medicine twice, slowed cries, one Short); none were uploaded. The PR says previews before merge.

No fresh analytics: the nightly job (06:40 UTC cron) had not fired by 12:35 UTC. It has fired 7–10 h late every day since Thursday (13:45, 14:52, 14:16, 16:20 UTC), so the dashboard is still yesterday's 16:27 UTC snapshot — 54 subscribers, 54,176 channel views, 150 videos, analytics through Nov 13 (3,097 views that day). Every experiment standing is identical to yesterday's.
Only one upload has happened since yesterday's brief (written 18:20 ET): the Generation 4 rapid-fire. The rest of the day's tally above was already in it.

ideas: Give the analytics workflow the same hourly watchdog dispatch the episodes workflow has: its 06:40 UTC cron fired at 13:45, 14:52, 14:16 and 16:20 UTC on the last four days, so this 07:35 ET brief has been reading day-old numbers every morning.

A rapid-fire viewer (3 likes, Fire-type 7-sound, Nov 13) says he got them "because of the small silhouette before the reveal" — in rapid-fire the ~2 s silhouette under the sting is working as a hint; worth a rapid-fire test of reveal-without-silhouette, keeping the art frame in the last 22 % for the thumbnail.
watch: PR #8: four previews rendered, none uploaded; the merge waits on your look. Until then the rapid-fire slots keep drawing from today's themes.

Cry test: original 73.8 vs modern 71.8 % viewed (n=14/16), unchanged — captions closed at a similar sample on a 3 % lead, so this could end at the next judgement; a tie now keeps the incumbent (modern).

CTA: score 75.3 vs subscribe 75.7 (n=6/7), unchanged. Series 76.8 vs plain 76.5 (n=6/2), ladder 77.2 vs chip 75.8 (n=6/2), loop ending 60.8 vs spoken 57.2 (n=3/5) — all still early; rapid-fire length and voice have no data yet (views7d needs a week).

The experiment tags don't separate the two groups; two of the three low ones were the 20 UTC slot, but Thursday's 20 UTC Short had 486.
